items.title: Chevron Stock Leads The Oil Price Shock Theme For Integrated Energy Investors
items.summary: Oil prices pushing toward triple digits, supply routes under threat and refineries disrupted have put global energy back in the spotlight. That mix creates both potential openings and risks for investors watching integrated oil and gas producers. items.title: Berkshire Cut Chevron By About a Third This Year and Kept Occidental. What Does That Say About Oil Prices?
items.summary: Berkshire sold some Chevron but held Occidental, the more oil-sensitive stock. That mix hints at a selective, not bearish, view of crude oil.
